## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users.

## Related issues

Link related issues (use "Closes #..." only when this fully resolves the issue).

## Validation

Describe checks actually run and their results. Explain anything not run.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, add Arabic/English or RTL examples when relevant. Remove personal data.

## Compatibility and rollout

Describe schema/configuration changes, queue or webhook requirements and recovery considerations. State "None" if not applicable. Merging this PR does not authorize deployment.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Ownership, payment and delivery boundaries are preserved where relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data or private files are included.
- [ ] Any migration preserves existing installations and encrypted data.
- [ ] Arabic/English, RTL and accessibility are considered where applicable.
